what_happened: deploy.yaml:34 uses image tag "latest"; policy POL-102 requires immutable pinned tags
why: Mutable tags make rollback and provenance unverifiable
how_to_fix: Run `pin-images deploy.yaml` or replace the tag with the build job output

what_happened: terraform/main.tf:12 provisions resource group in region east-2; policy POL-204 requires region west-1
why: Data residency requirements only permit the approved region
how_to_fix: Change `location = "east-2"` to `location = "west-1"` in terraform/main.tf:12 and re-plan

what_happened: requirements.lock:88 pins example-lib 1.2.0 with CVE-2026-0001; policy POL-501 requires no known-vulnerable pins
why: A known-vulnerable dependency is an exploitable surface until patched
how_to_fix: Run `polx bump example-lib --to 1.2.1` and commit the lockfile

what_happened: Dockerfile:21 installs `curl` without a checksum; policy POL-302 requires verified downloads
why: Unverified downloads allow tampered artifacts into the image
how_to_fix: Pin the download to a checksummed release: fetch the file, verify with `sha256sum -c sha256s.txt`, then install
